row.title: DISPOSE-1: every open item gets a coded disposition inside 14 days on the fleet pass
row.body: Rowan, 2026-11-20: nothing sits in the queue for months and no client-side code agent is assumed. Measured that day: 304 open item files (168 in the executor queue), 58 of 74 executor runs failed. foundation/dispose.py closes an open item as gate (owner-bound) or shelved (three failed executor runs, or open ttl_days) from foundation/queue.py run(); foundation/contracts.py records fixed when a disposed item's probe passes and does not reopen it; queue.takeable retries shelved items when the open queue is empty.

title: DISPOSE-1: every open item gets a coded disposition inside 14 days on the fleet pass
